git_scope: Blobless clone checked out at the pinned commit, the head when retrieved and eleven commits past the c75bebd pin, with no issue asking. In scope are the fourteen direct-packing folders added in e646c47 and c284cd0, with each certificate in three formats, notes, checksums and the two checkers' outputs; the licence, attribution, README, changelog, verification report, manifest and standalone checker verify.py at the root; and tools/rectcheck.py and Evan Daniel's verify_cert.py with its notice, the other two checkers VERIFICATION.md runs on the direct certificates. The fourteen drawings and 40-digit decimal exports are pinned by digest only, and tools/verify_cert_daniel.py by digest against the identical copy the issue-399 packet retains. The folders n0308, n0343 and n0344 are unchanged since c75bebd and stay in fang-two-wedge-certificates-2026-10-10; theorem/, composites/, rectangles/, third_party/ and tools/glue.py are another packet's subject. No program was executed.

claims: Every count lies beyond the n <= 324 case corpus. Each certificate is a finite construction found by a time-budgeted penalty search from a two-wedge seed: Francisco Couzo's packing of 342 squares for 380 and 381, and through 381 for 421; Evan Daniel's improved packing of 343 for 382; and a parametric seed for the other ten. No exact form, local minimality or optimality is claimed. The n0508 side is below the n0507 side, so it also bounds s(507).
